notes:
Fixes the Simple IPTV Update false-negative state detection by no longer querying the PVR client while the PVR manager is still shutting down.

Adds a short settling phase before re-enabling Adult IPTV and verifies successful reload using the actual Adult TV Test channel state after IPTV Simple has restarted.

Adds Cumination-style hover switching for the Senderliste erstellen, Senderstatus prüfen and Release Notes tabs while keeping Create, Update, OK and Abbrechen as click-only actions.

Extends the Simple IPTV Prüfen result notification duration so failed channel names remain visible longer.

Penthouse Passion TV and Playboy TV currently fail with source-side HTTP 404 responses; both were confirmed unavailable on the source website, so no resolver workaround is applied.

Normal Custom Site playback, resolver logic, playlist generation, thumbnails, Landscape Wall support and update-check behavior remain otherwise unchanged from v1.93.

This is an experimental pre-release and may contain bugs or incomplete features.
